 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. CLEVELAND — It will be a homecoming for a few players Saturday, Nov. 14, when the Cavaliers host the Dallas Mavericks .
 The Mavs are 10th in the Western Conference with a record of 7-5. Former Cavs star and 2016 champion Kyrie Irving returns to The Land and Tyrese Proctor will play against his former Duke teammate Cooper Flagg.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Cavs have a quick turnaround after losing 133-121 in Miami to the Heat on Nov. 13. Donovan Mitchell led the Cavs with 25 points, and Proctor added 22 points.
 The Mavs are coming off a 133-94 loss to the Minnesota Timberwolves Nov. 12 in Minnesota. Flagg had 12 points, seven rebounds and three assists, and Irving had 10 points, four assists and three rebounds. The Mavs' leading scorer was Zaccharie Risacher with 22 points.
 Tip-off is scheduled for 7:30 p.m. Follow along for live updates .
 Cavs starting lineup
 This post will be updated as soon as the starting lineup is official.
 Cavs injury report
 The following players are out:
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Peyton Watson: Hamstring
 Donovan Mitchell: Left knee
 Jarrett Allen: Right knee
 James Harden: Calf
 Sam Merrill: Right elbow injury
 Evan Mobley: Left toe sprain
 Nae'Qwan Tomlin: Lower back
 Ernest Udeh, Jr.: Two-way player
 Khalif Diop: Two-way player
 Mavs injury report
 No injuries reported
 Where can I watch Cavaliers vs Dallas tonight on TV?
 Cavs versus Mavs will be televised by DAZN , which will stream all regular-season games not selected exclusively for national broadcasts. It will also be on WOIO, channel 19 and RESN. 
 Those DAZN telecasts will be available to DIRECTV customers who subscribe to the choice or higher packages and to U-verse TV customers who subscribe to the U200 or higher package, according to a news release.
 How can I listen to Cavs vs Mavs tonight on radio?
 The local radio broadcast of the Cavs-Mavs game can be heard via WTAM (1100-AM), WMMS (100.7-FM) or La Mega Cleveland (Spanish broadcast, 1300-AM).
